Manufacturers Test Certificate against each week of manufacture as mentioned in the bag of c ement. b. Delivery Challan/Invoice mentioning week of manufacture of cement. 7. The cost of the above testing including transportation charge s shall be borne by the supplier. In case Cement fails to achieve the desired minimum 28 days compressive strength as per IS 14 89 PART-I, Supplier has to replace the total lot without any extra financial implication to NTPC.
